snippet.title: My Little Animal Care Center | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5569030/

Run a cozy little animal clinic in the heart of a colorful town!

Treat hurt pets on the care table, look after boarders in their pens, welcome over a dozen species and grow your center.

#cozygames #indiegame
